sentences.text:
This application coming on for hearing this day, the cou  following:
 ORDER With the consent, heard finally.
Perused the case diary.

This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of bail to the applicant, as he has been arrested on 26.05.2022 in connection with Crime No.54/2022 registered at Police Station Myana, District Guna (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Section 376 of IPC.

Prosecution case, in brief, is that on 09.03.2022 at about 17:30 hours, the prosecutrix aged about 50 years was returning from village Bagalamar to village Nagera and when she reached near the field of Shambhu Patel, then applicant forcefully took her to the field and committed sexual intercourse with her.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent a n d has falsely been implicated in the matter.

He further submits that the prosecution case apparently appears suspicious, as the prosecutrix is a major and married lady aged about 50 years and during MLC, no internal or external injury was found on her body.
The applicant is in custody since 26.05.2022 and has suffered more than one year jail incarceration.
His custodial interrogation or trial is not required in the matter.
Trial will take time for its conclusion.
Hence, prayer is made to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposes the application.

Having considered the rival submissions, material pointed out by learned counsel for the applicant,
specially the age of the prosecutrix, her MLC report and statement recorded during investigation, so also period of custody of the applicant as well as other facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail, hence, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during the pendency of trial.
It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C.
This application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per rules.

(SATYENDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE bj/-
